Notes:
  - This runtime consumes latent_mechanisms, scoring mechanism_edges, axis_couplings, and risk-factor modulation fields.
  - geometry_first mode makes diagnosis ranking emerge from axis residuals, trajectories, couplings, mechanism gates, risk/background modifiers, and case observations.
  - legacy anchor/bonus/missing-anchor/duration penalties are retained only behind VESMED_RANKING_PHILOSOPHY=legacy_scaffold for regression comparison.
  - mechanism_audit_origin edges are registry/audit evidence only and are not used as scoring gates.
  - Pair candidates are two-disease vector-field superpositions, not labels emitted by the LLM.
  - Opposing disease forces are combined in standardized axis space so a strong TTP platelet-consumption field is not canceled by weak AOSD reactive thrombocytosis.
  - Illness detection reports logP_best_known - logP_health_reference; disease identity is ranked only among disease manifolds.
  - Formal health_reference_manifold axes and reusable response_models are loaded when present; response axes can be scored through expected-response / response-failure factorization instead of direct disease-axis double counting.
  - Evidence mode controls post-workup evidence: presentation mode excludes microbiology/pathology/confirmatory/course sections unless a case or item explicitly declares stage availability.
